manual mutations (each reverted, file cmp-verified): revoke on expired, acceptUrl always shown, unknown code not mapped to unknown, inviteError ignored

notes: Oracle runs the REAL api-client and hooks against a stubbed global fetch, asserting method, path and Bearer of POST /, /:id/resend and /:id/revoke; only @/auth/react and the Radix Dialog/AlertDialog shells are mocked (context-aware stand-ins).

Create reads the outcome from the 201 BODY: `inviteError` -> createFailed outcome (seller saved line + copy by code), else delivery fields. Resend/revoke failures read ApiError.code (falling back to `error`, e.g. bare 404 `not_found`).

Every warning/error renders through admin.sellers.invitation.{warnings,errors}.<code>; INVITE_ERROR_CODES whitelists codes with copy, anything else renders errors.unknown. Server `message` is never rendered (oracle asserts a sentinel message is absent). pt copy mirrors the API INVITATION_COPY strings.

Outcome dialog (one Dialog for create/resend/revoke-error): email_not_configured shows the single-use acceptUrl in a code block + Copiar link (KeyRevealModal pattern); acceptUrl lives only in outcome state, cleared on close; oracle spies every console level and asserts the token never appears. email_failed offers Reenviar in the dialog. application_url_missing is an amber operator note. hub_auth_not_configured is its own operator copy and the new row (Sem convite) stays visible.

Rows: new Convite column (Badge: accepted default, pending secondary, expired outline, revoked destructive, null outline muted 'Sem convite'), rendered verbatim from SellerRow.invitationStatus. Resend on pending/expired, Revoke on pending only (accepted/revoked/uninvited get none, since resend of an uninvited seller is a guaranteed 409). Actions cell has a fixed h-9 so rows with and without buttons line up. Both row buttons disable while either mutation runs for that row; Loader2 spinner on the active one (repo pattern).
Revoke asks for confirmation via AlertDialog (Voltar / Revogar convite), never window.confirm.

api-client: ApiError gained optional retryAfterSeconds (body field first, then a numeric Retry-After header; headers read is optional-chained because minimal fetch fakes have none). Added CreateSellerResult / SellerInviteDelivery / SellerInviteError types and adminSellersApi.resendInvitation / revokeInvitation (POST, no body, server defaults locale pt-BR).

FOLLOW-UP (server, not in this slice): resend/revoke 429 bodies carry no retryAfterSeconds (only the create inviteError does) and the API CORS config does not expose Retry-After, so cross-origin (staging/prod) the resend rate-limit copy falls back to the generic 'Aguarde um pouco' text. Fix: put retryAfterSeconds in failureResponse's body, or add exposeHeaders: ['Retry-After'] in apps/api/src/middleware/cors.ts.
